content: Replacing <table> markup with <div> wrappers for flex layouts is safe and well-supported across all modern browsers. The existing todos.css.scss already overrides table/tbody/tr with display:block/flex, so switching the HTML to divs requires only a selector rename (table.todo-form -> div.todo-form, tr -> .todo-form-row). The div approach avoids edge cases in table intrinsic sizing that can occur even when display:block is set on <table> — particularly the table-layout algorithm and minimum column width calculations that some browsers still apply.
